directionsExplored.name: Quiet Institutional (Selected)
directionsExplored.summary: Restrained investment-firm aesthetic with warm ivory (#F7F5F0) primary canvas, editorial serif headlines, fine architectural borders, subtle champagne gold (#C6AD7A) details, and deep midnight navy (#101A24) anchor chambers.

directionsExplored.name: Modern Investment Studio
directionsExplored.summary: All-dark contemporary aesthetic using midnight navy (#101A24) and charcoal (#17191C), asymmetric layouts, and high-contrast display typography.

directionsExplored.name: Editorial Founder-First
directionsExplored.summary: Magazine-inspired long-form narrative layout with oversized pull quotes and essay-style single-column progression.

decisions.rationale: Quiet Institutional (Direction A) achieves the highest marks across brand credibility, readability, founder appeal, and mobile usability while honoring the real-world entrepreneurial heritage associated with Dee Vee Projects Limited through subtle architectural drafting grids and corner crosshairs.
